title: Sheep Behavior Reversion
description: This datapack reverts the 1.21.5 update changes to sheep behavior, preventing them from eating short grass, ferns, short dry grass, and tall dry grass.
body: This datapack reverts the 1.21.5 update changes to sheep behavior, preventing them from eating short grass, ferns, short dry grass, and tall dry grass. I created this to protect decorative builds in survival worlds, eliminating the inconvenience of dealing with sheep consuming foliage blocks while still allowing them to graze on renewable grass blocks.
